content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela face significant challenges when trying to sell their products online. Conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-what-actually-how-2|payment]] processors like PayPal and Stripe are often unavailable or impose high fees. This breakdown explores how to establish a digital product store with no-KYC payments, enabling creators to keep more of their earnings while maintaining full control over their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-2|The Full]].

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store without KYC (Know Your Customer) payments offers creators a way to sell directly to their audience without the barriers imposed by traditional payment processors. This is crucial in regions where financial services are limited or where creators face high transaction fees. With systems like NOWPayments, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a mere 0.5% fee, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale. This model not only enhances profitability but also ensures that creators maintain [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-11|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]]ty over their income and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure of a no-KYC digital product store is built on layers of free and open-source tools. At the front end, platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as hosting solutions. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the processing seamlessly. Order storage can be managed using Supabase or even Google Sheets, while digital product delivery is facilitated via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which verifies transactions automatically on-chain, providing instant product delivery without relying on conventional payment methods.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are limited. Whether you’re selling ebooks, templates, or software, this system empowers you to bypass the restrictions that typically stifle your ability to monetize your work. By choosing this architecture, you gain the ability to manage your store without intermediaries, resulting in higher profit margins and greater operational flexibility. Creators in markets like Ghana, Kenya, and Zimbabwe can leverage this setup to thrive in a digital economy that often overlooks them.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of a no-KYC digital product store relies on several interconnected components. The hosting solution provides the foundation where your products reside. Backend logic orchestrates the functionality, ensuring everything runs smoothly. Order storage holds transaction data securely, while automated delivery guarantees that customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation. Finally, NOWPayments offers a seamless payment processing solution that accommodates various cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a global audience without the complications of traditional banking.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To establish your own no-KYC digital product store, start by selecting a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions. Choose your order storage method, whether it's Supabase or Google Sheets, and prepare your digital products for delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your setup effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a no-KYC payment solution like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrencies while maintaining full control over your sales process. With a digital product store built on free tools, you can bypass traditional payment barriers and retain more of your earnings.
You retain full control over your data and infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for ways to sell ebooks or templates without relying on conventional platforms, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary blueprints and templates. This kit enables you to create a fully operational store, ensuring you can monetize your digital products effectively. Explore the options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook by setting up a digital product store using tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments. This allows you to accept crypto payments directly without relying on traditional payment processors.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Utilizing a no-KYC payment processor like NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads with minimal fees. This setup keeps more revenue in your pocket compared to platforms that charge high transaction fees.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by creating your own digital store with infrastructure tools, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your audience, avoiding the fees imposed by platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What cryptocurrencies can I use for payments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, enabling you to accept a wide array of digital currencies for your products. This flexibility caters to a global audience.
How do I ensure instant delivery of digital products?
By using automated delivery methods through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, you can ensure that your customers receive their digital products immediately after payment confirmation.
